next.reason: 1985 (1993 amendment): 'The text produced as a result of the complete processing of a COPY statement must not contain a COPY statement', so no copied text may hold a COPY. 2023 is looser. §2023:7.2.3.3 SR1 allows a COPY statement 'in source text or in library text'. §2023:7.2.3.4 GR12 says 'If the REPLACING phrase is not specified, the library text may contain a COPY statement that does not include a REPLACING phrase', and requires support for at least 5 nesting levels. The bar remains only where §2023:7.2.3.4 GR10 applies ('If the REPLACING phrase is specified, the library text shall not contain a COPY statement') and where §2023:7.2.3.4 GR13 applies ('The replacing action of a COPY statement shall not introduce a COPY statement'). A program 1985 must refuse, nested COPY without REPLACING, is legal in 2023. Both editions check this at compile time; no exception condition is involved.
